newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average rises more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average rises more than 50 points.

text.p: Blue chip stocks rose more than 50 points on Monday as investors, emboldened by Friday's sharp 130-point gain, picked up where they left off.

At 10:07 a.m. EDT, the Dow Jones industrial average was up 51.08 points at 7,486.86, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading. The Nasdaq composite index, laden with high-tech issues, rose 7.49 points to 1,412.33.
